local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")

local PackData = require(Shared:WaitForChild("PackData"))

function CardService.RollCard(player: Player, packId: string?): (CardData.CardDef, TraitData.TraitDef)
	local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
	local totalLuck = (data.LuckMultiplier or 1.0)

	local pack = packId and PackData.GetPackById(packId)
	if pack then
		totalLuck = totalLuck * pack.LuckMultiplier
	end

	-- Weighted Roll for Card
	local weightedCards = {}
	local totalWeight = 0

	for _, card in ipairs(CardData.Cards) do
		local weight = card.Weight
		if card.Rarity ~= "Comum" then
			weight = weight * totalLuck
		end
		table.insert(weightedCards, { Card = card, Weight = weight })
		totalWeight += weight
	end

	local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
	local currentWeight = 0
	local selectedCard = CardData.Cards[1]

	for _, item in ipairs(weightedCards) do
		currentWeight += item.Weight
		if roll <= currentWeight then
			selectedCard = item.Card
			break
		end
	end

	-- Weighted Roll for Trait / Mutator
	local totalTraitWeight = 0
	local weightedTraits = {}
	for _, trait in pairs(TraitData.Traits) do
		local w = trait.Weight
		if trait.Id ~= "Normal" then
			w = w * (totalLuck ^ 0.5)
		end
		table.insert(weightedTraits, { Trait = trait, Weight = w })
		totalTraitWeight += w
	end

	local traitRoll = math.random() * totalTraitWeight
	local currentTraitWeight = 0
	local selectedTrait = TraitData.Traits.Normal

	for _, item in ipairs(weightedTraits) do
		currentTraitWeight += item.Weight
		if traitRoll <= currentTraitWeight then
			selectedTrait = item.Trait
			break
		end
	end

	return selectedCard, selectedTrait
end

function CardService.CreateCardInstance(cardDef: CardData.CardDef, traitDef: TraitData.TraitDef, level: number?)
	local lvl = level or 1
	local income = cardDef.BaseIncome * traitDef.Multiplier * (1 + (lvl - 1) * 0.25)
	local gradeInfo = CardGradeService.CalculateGrade(cardDef.Rarity, traitDef.Id, lvl)

	return {
		UniqueId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		Id = cardDef.Id,
		Name = cardDef.Name,
		Anime = cardDef.Anime,
		Rarity = cardDef.Rarity,
		Mutator = traitDef.Name,
		TraitId = traitDef.Id,
		MutatorMultiplier = traitDef.Multiplier,
		Level = lvl,
		Income = income,
		Grade = gradeInfo.Grade,
		GradeScore = gradeInfo.Score,
		GradeColor = { R = gradeInfo.Color.R, G = gradeInfo.Color.G, B = gradeInfo.Color.B },
	}
end

function CardService.UpgradeCardLevel(player: Player, invIndex: number): boolean
	local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
	local cardInst = data.Inventory[invIndex]
	if not cardInst then return false end

	local cost = math.floor(cardInst.Income * 15 * (cardInst.Level or 1))
	if data.Cash < cost then return false end

	data.Cash -= cost
	cardInst.Level = (cardInst.Level or 1) + 1
	
	local trait = TraitData.GetTrait(cardInst.TraitId or "Normal")
	local cardDef = CardData.GetCardById(cardInst.Id)
	local baseIncome = cardDef and cardDef.BaseIncome or 10
	
	cardInst.Income = baseIncome * trait.Multiplier * (1 + (cardInst.Level - 1) * 0.25)
	local newGrade = CardGradeService.CalculateGrade(cardInst.Rarity, trait.Id, cardInst.Level)
	cardInst.Grade = newGrade.Grade
	cardInst.GradeScore = newGrade.Score

	return true
end

function CardService.StartPassiveIncomeLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local Players = game:GetService("Players")
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
				if data and data.PlacedCards then
					local cashMultiplier = data.CashMultiplier or 1.0
					local totalPerSec = 0

					for _, cardInst in pairs(data.PlacedCards) do
						if cardInst and cardInst.Income then
							totalPerSec += cardInst.Income
						end
					end

					if totalPerSec > 0 then
						local earned = totalPerSec * cashMultiplier
						data.Cash = (data.Cash or 0) + earned
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CardService

	Raro = 80,
	Épico = 200,
	Lendário = 500,
	Mítico = 1500,
	Divino = 5000,
	Caos = 20000,
}

function CardGradeService.CalculateGrade(rarity: string, traitId: string, level: number): GradeInfo
	local basePower = RARITY_POWER[rarity] or 10
	local trait = TraitData.GetTrait(traitId)
	local traitMult = trait and trait.Multiplier or 1.0
	local lvlMult = 1.0 + ((level or 1) - 1) * 0.25

	local score = basePower * traitMult * lvlMult

	local grade = "E"
	local color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	local stars = 1

	if score >= 5000000 then
		grade = "SUPREMO+"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
		stars = 7
	elseif score >= 1000000 then
		grade = "DIVINO"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 230)
		stars = 6
	elseif score >= 250000 then
		grade = "SSS"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
		stars = 5
	elseif score >= 50000 then
		grade = "SS"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
		stars = 5
	elseif score >= 10000 then
		grade = "S"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 240)
		stars = 4
	elseif score >= 2500 then
		grade = "A"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 250)
		stars = 3
	elseif score >= 800 then
		grade = "B"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120)
		stars = 3
	elseif score >= 200 then
		grade = "C"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
		stars = 2
	elseif score >= 50 then
		grade = "D"
		color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
		stars = 1
	end

	return {
		Grade = grade,
		Score = math.floor(score),
		Color = color,
		Stars = stars,
	}
end

return CardGradeService

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local UpgradeData = require(Shared:WaitForChild("UpgradeData"))
local PlayerDataStore = require(script.Parent.PlayerDataStore)

local UpgradeManager = {}

function UpgradeManager.BuyUpgrade(player: Player, upgradeId: string): boolean
	local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
	local def = UpgradeData.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not def then return false end

	local currentLevel = data.Upgrades[upgradeId] or 0
	if currentLevel >= def.MaxLevel then
		return false -- Already maxed
	end

	local cost = UpgradeData.GetCost(upgradeId, currentLevel)
	if data.Cash < cost then
		return false -- Insufficient funds
	end

	-- Deduct cash and increment level
	data.Cash -= cost
	data.Upgrades[upgradeId] = currentLevel + 1

	-- Apply upgrade effect
	if upgradeId == "LuckBoost" then

local function deepCopy(t: any): any
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy
end

local function reconcileData(data: any): any
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
	end

	for k, v in pairs(DEFAULT_DATA) do
		if data[k] == nil then
			data[k] = deepCopy(v)
		elseif type(v) == "table" and type(data[k]) == "table" then
			for subK, subV in pairs(v) do
				if data[k][subK] == nil then
					data[k][subK] = subV
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return data
end

function PlayerDataStore.Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		PlayerDataStore.LoadData(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		PlayerDataStore.SaveData(player)
		sessionData[player.UserId] = nil
	end)

	-- Save all players on Server Shutdown
	game:BindToClose(function()
		isShuttingDown = true
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			PlayerDataStore.SaveData(player)
		end
	end)

	-- Periodic Auto-Save every 60s
	task.spawn(function()
		while not isShuttingDown do
			task.wait(60)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				PlayerDataStore.SaveData(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function PlayerDataStore.LoadData(player: Player): any
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local attempts = 0
	local success, result = false, nil

	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		success, result = pcall(function()
			return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
		end)
		if not success or result == nil then
			sessionData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
			return sessionData[player.UserId]
		end
	else
		repeat
			attempts += 1
			success, result = pcall(function()
				return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
			end)
			if not success then
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		until success or attempts >= 2
	end

	if success and result and type(result) == "table" then
		sessionData[player.UserId] = reconcileData(result)
	else
		sessionData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
	end

	return sessionData[player.UserId]
end

function PlayerDataStore.GetData(player: Player): any
	if not sessionData[player.UserId] then
		return PlayerDataStore.LoadData(player)
	end
	return sessionData[player.UserId]
end

function PlayerDataStore.SaveData(player: Player)
	local data = sessionData[player.UserId]
	if not data then return end

	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local attempts = 0
	local success = false

	repeat
		attempts += 1
		success = pcall(function()
			dataStore:SetAsync(key, data)
		end)
		if not success then
			task.wait(1)
		end
	until success or attempts >= 3
end

return PlayerDataStore

	local spawner = plotModel:FindFirstChild("PackSpawner") :: BasePart?
	local collector = plotModel:FindFirstChild("CollectorPad") :: BasePart?

		prompt.ObjectText = "Pacote de Spawn"
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.Parent = promptPart

		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggerPlayer)
			if triggerPlayer == player then
				ConveyorManager.SpawnPackOnConveyor(plotModel, player, "iniciante")
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Auto Spawner Loop based on Conveyor Speed upgrade
	task.spawn(function()
		while plotModel and plotModel.Parent and player and player.Parent do
			local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
			local speedLvl = data.Upgrades.ConveyorSpeed or 0
			local interval = math.max(0.8, 3.0 - (speedLvl * 0.1))
			task.wait(interval)

			ConveyorManager.SpawnPackOnConveyor(plotModel, player, "iniciante")
		end
	end)
end

function ConveyorManager.SpawnPackOnConveyor(plotModel: Model, player: Player, packId: string)
	local spawner = plotModel:FindFirstChild("PackSpawner") :: BasePart?
	local collector = plotModel:FindFirstChild("CollectorPad") :: BasePart?
	if not spawner or not collector then return end

	local packDef = PackData.GetPackById(packId) or PackData.Packs.Iniciante

	-- Create visual Card Box on conveyor
	local box = Instance.new("Part")
	box.Name = "CardPackBox"
	box.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2.8, 0.4)
	box.CFrame = spawner.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	box.Color = packDef.Color
	box.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	box.Anchored = true
	box.CanCollide = false
	box.Parent = plotModel

	-- Add SelectionBox / Highlight glow
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.FillColor = packDef.Color
	highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
	highlight.Parent = box

	-- SurfaceGui for Pack Label
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.Parent = box

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = packDef.Name
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.Parent = gui

	-- Tween box along conveyor to Collector
	local targetCFrame = collector.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	local distance = (box.Position - collector.Position).Magnitude
	local speed = 8 -- studs per second
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(distance / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)

	local tween = TweenService:Create(box, tweenInfo, { CFrame = targetCFrame })
	tween:Play()

	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		box:Destroy()
		-- Collect pack and grant card to player
		local cardDef, mutatorDef = CardService.RollCard(player, packId)
		local cardInst = CardService.CreateCardInstance(cardDef, mutatorDef)

		local data = PlayerDataStore.GetData(player)
		table.insert(data.Inventory, cardInst)

		-- Notify client of card obtained
		local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared")
		local NetworkEvents = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NetworkEvents"))
		NetworkEvents.GetEvent("CardSpawned"):FireClient(player, cardInst)
	end)
end

return ConveyorManager

--!strict
local FormatUtils = {}

local SUFFIXES = {
	"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi", "Sx", "Sp", "Oc", "No", "Dc",
	"Ud", "Dd", "Td", "Qad", "Qid", "Sxd", "Spd", "Ocd", "Nod", "Vig", "Cent"
}

function FormatUtils.FormatMoney(value: number): string
	if value < 0 then
		return "-" .. FormatUtils.FormatMoney(-value)
	end
	if value < 1000 then
		return string.format("$%.2f", value):gsub("%.00$", "")
	end

	local exp = math.floor(math.log10(value) / 3)
	exp = math.min(exp, #SUFFIXES - 1)
	local scaled = value / (10 ^ (exp * 3))
	local suffix = SUFFIXES[exp + 1]

	return string.format("$%.2f%s", scaled, suffix)
end

function FormatUtils.FormatNumber(value: number): string
	if value < 1000 then
		return string.format("%.0f", value)
	end
	local exp = math.floor(math.log10(value) / 3)
	exp = math.min(exp, #SUFFIXES - 1)
	local scaled = value / (10 ^ (exp * 3))
	local suffix = SUFFIXES[exp + 1]

	return string.format("%.2f%s", scaled, suffix)
end

function FormatUtils.FormatPercent(value: number): string
	return string.format("+%.0f%%", value * 100)
end

function FormatUtils.FormatChance(chanceFraction: number): string
	if chanceFraction >= 1 then
		return "100%"
	elseif chanceFraction >= 0.01 then
		return string.format("%.1f%%", chanceFraction * 100)
	else
		local oneIn = math.floor(1 / chanceFraction + 0.5)
		return string.format("1 em %s", FormatUtils.FormatNumber(oneIn))
	end
end

function FormatUtils.FormatTime(seconds: number): string
	local mins = math.floor(seconds / 60)
	local secs = math.floor(seconds % 60)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
end

return FormatUtils
